# Show who sent each message in shared threads

## What to build

Record the author of every user message and show the sender's name and avatar on messages from other members in a shared thread. Add a nullable `Message.authorUserId`, set it wherever a user message is created, expose `sender: { userId, name, image }` on `ThreadMessage` and on live `thread.message.created` events, and render it on web (and desktop, which hosts web) and mobile above user messages that were sent by someone other than the viewer. Your own messages look exactly as today; reply previews name the other member instead of "You".

Already in the codebase: threads/messages are shared across members of a space (queries by `spaceId`), approval cards carry `waitingOn`/`trigger` (`packages/contracts/src/events.ts` ask block), and `seedSharedSpaceFixture` from `@rakazo/db` gives `{ spaceId, owner, member, outsider, cleanup }`.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma` 806-833 (`Message`: no user column today).
- `packages/db/src/messages.ts` 55-108 (`CreateThreadMessageInput`, `tx.message.create({ data: { threadId, seq, role, blocks, botId, replyToMessageId, replyQuote, runId, clientNonce } })`).
- `packages/db/src/events.ts` 464-638 `sendUserMessage` (creates the `role: "user"` message at ~505-510 without the user; live payload `{ messageId, role: "user", blocks, callId }` at ~595-604), ~935-955 (call answer utterances), steering messages (`SteeringMessage.userId`, schema 938-960).
- `apps/api/src/thread-target.ts` 725+ `sendThreadMessage` → `createThreadMessageInTransaction(tx, { threadId, role: "user", ... })` ~857-860; answer paths 688, 872, 1075, 1389 that create user-visible answer messages.
- `packages/contracts/src/events.ts` 443-457 (`ThreadMessageSchema`), 58 (`MessageRole`).
- `apps/api/src/thread-message-pages.ts` 253-295 (`toThreadMessage(row)`) — include the author (one batched `user.findMany` for the page's distinct `authorUserId`s; never N+1).
- Web: `apps/web/src/pages/shell/message-view.tsx` 158-176 (speaker line with `BotAvatar` + `speakerName`, bots only), 182-187 (reply author hard-coded `t\`You\``), 291-296 (user messages right-aligned), 491-509 (user bubble); `apps/web/src/pages/shell/transcript.tsx` 539-545 (`speakerName` only for `role === "bot"`). Reuse the existing user avatar component (grep `UserAvatar\|AccountAvatar\|avatarStyle` in `apps/web/src`); do not create a new one if one exists.
- Gallery: `apps/web/e2e/fixtures/gallery.tsx` 27-48 (`user(text, extra)` helper), `team` scenario at 416 — add two user messages from another member with `sender` so `gallery.spec.ts` screenshots it.
- Mobile: `apps/mobile/components/thread/message-bubble.tsx` 468-491 (`showBotSenderName`, speaker only for bots), 696-730 (`MessageTextCard`), `apps/mobile/components/thread/message-row.tsx` 101, 386; tests in `apps/mobile/lib` (pattern `apps/mobile/lib/ask-card.test.tsx`).

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261111180000_message_author/migration.sql`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `-- Additive: older releases never read this column.` `ALTER TABLE "messages" ADD COLUMN "authorUserId" TEXT REFERENCES "user"("id") ON DELETE SET NULL;` (no index needed). Add `authorUserId String?` + relation (`onDelete: SetNull`) on `Message` and the back-relation on `User`.
- **GOTCHA**: previous release keeps inserting messages without the column — it is nullable, so that is fine. No backfill.

### UPDATE `messages.ts`, `events.ts`, `thread-target.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `authorUserId` on `CreateThreadMessageInput`; set it for every `role: "user"` message from a person (send, steering, answers, call utterances). Live event payload includes `sender` for user messages.

### UPDATE contracts and `thread-message-pages.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `sender: z.object({ userId: Id, name: z.string(), image: z.string().nullable() }).optional()` on `ThreadMessageSchema`; mapper fills it.

### UPDATE web and mobile renderers
- **IMPLEMENT**: for `role === "user"` and `message.sender && message.sender.userId !== currentUserId`, show the sender's name and avatar like the bot speaker line (left of the bubble group, same typography); reply preview uses the sender's name. Own messages unchanged. Name text only; no new labels.
- **GOTCHA**: web Lingui extract if any string changes; mobile strings in all 7 locales (gate `apps/mobile/lib/i18n.test.ts`).
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm --filter @rakazo/web check && pnpm --filter @rakazo/mobile check`

### TESTS
- `apps/api/src/message-author.postgres.test.ts` with `seedSharedSpaceFixture`: owner and member each send a message in the owner's bot thread → messages page returns `sender.userId` for each; bot messages have no `sender`; outsider cannot read the page.
- Web unit test for `message-view` rendering another member's name and not the viewer's own; mobile unit test in `apps/mobile/lib`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] New user messages store `authorUserId`; old messages render as before.
- [ ] `ThreadMessage.sender` present for user messages with a known author.
- [ ] Web, desktop and mobile show the sender's name and avatar for other members' messages only.

## Validation commands

```bash
pnpm db:generate
pnpm check --affected || pnpm check
pnpm lint
pnpm exec vitest run apps/api/src apps/web/src/pages/shell
pnpm --filter @rakazo/mobile test
pnpm test:integration -- --spec=message-author
```

## Project rules that apply (from AGENTS.md)

- Public repo: no secrets, real emails or private URLs in code, tests or fixtures. Test emails use `@rakazo.test`.
- Use top-level `import type`, never inline type imports. Dynamic `import()` only for deferred loading.
- Migrations must work with the previous release running side by side: only add tables/columns (nullable or with a default). Never drop or rename in this task. Folder name `packages/db/prisma/migrations/YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_snake_name/migration.sql`; use a timestamp after `20261110120000` and unique to this task (the suffix in this task's text). First line is a comment such as `-- Additive: older releases never read or write these columns.`
- Every table with row-level security must be listed in `ROW_SECURITY_MODELS` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:96`), enforced by `packages/db/src/row-security.postgres.test.ts:789-799`. New tables follow `packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261109120000_audit_events/migration.sql:57-60` (ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY + a `_system` policy on `current_setting('app.rls_bypass', true) = 'on'`) and `20261022120000_row_level_security_tenant_tables` for tenant policies.
- Database access in tests and app code must run inside `runAsTenant` / `runAsSystem` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:27-40`); the vitest setup (`packages/testkit/src/pin-test-env.ts`) fails a suite that touches the database outside them.
- Tests are deterministic and offline. Postgres suites are `*.postgres.test.ts`, skipped unless `VERIFY_DATABASE=1` and `DATABASE_URL` are set (`describe.skipIf(!enabled).sequential(...)`, see `apps/api/src/board-rename.postgres.test.ts:10-13`).
- The API owns authorization and validation; frontends express intent and render state.
- Keep UI copy minimal: no explainer text that repeats the interface. Colors only via `@rakazo/ui-tokens` semantic tokens; reuse `packages/ui-web` components.
- Coordinate across instances through Postgres (transactions, advisory locks, claims), never in-process locks or in-memory counters.
- Do not run the desktop Playwright suite (`pnpm --filter @rakazo/desktop test:e2e`) locally.
